shortDefinition: Melusina installs as a Progressive Web App with content-free push notifications and offline access.

children.text: Melusina's PWA support lets users install the platform as a native-feeling app on any device. The service worker provides offline access and caching, while push notifications keep users informed.
Content-free pushes: payloads are deliberately empty ('something happened')—no data leaks through the push service.
DDP-aware: pushes only fire when the user lacks an active real-time Meteor connection, avoiding duplicate alerts.
Service worker: offline access, resource caching, and background sync.

seo.title: PWA & Push Notifications
seo.description: Definition of PWA support in Melusina with content-free push notifications.
